description: Render L_water-flow, B_water-flow, B_continuation, B_entrance (currently invisible) and fix B_blocks (currently dropped) as ground-anchored vector icons: line geometry sized in meters, stroked with the L_wall line width, identical across the matplotlib survey plot, the Folium satellite map and the KMZ export (icons scale with zoom like the survey, no pushpins/PNGs). Continuation is a '?', water-flow is an S-wiggle with an arrowhead oriented by the DXF INSERT rotation. Backend-only (cave_sketch/), ships to webapp and Android via the Chaquopy symlink.
